slides.title: The gap is closing fast
text: When the 50-day average drops under the 200-day, traders call it a [death cross].
Bitcoin is {52%} below its Oct 2025 top.
slides.source: CoinDesk Nov 27 (3.45% gap, 12% a month earlier); Coin Metrics PriceUSD SMA calc (3.8% Nov 26, 12.1% Oct 27); top close $124,753 Oct 6 2025 (Yahoo) / $124,824 (Coin Metrics) vs ~$59.8K Nov 27

slides.title: 13 death crosses since 2011
text: The catch: averages lag, so the cross shows up [after] the fall has started.
slides.source: CoinDesk Nov 27 (13 signals; 59/64/66% deepest; 0.3/2.9/5.7% shallowest); Coin Metrics calc (13 crosses, 62/64/64% and 0.0/1.8/3.9%; middle 7 between 11.6% and 53.4%)

sources: CoinDesk, Nov 27 2026 (Omkar Godbole): 50-day SMA ~3.45% above 200-day, from 12% a month earlier; 13 previous death crosses; median ~24% drop to the low before the next golden cross; deepest 66% (Sep 4 2014), 64% (Jan 14 2022), 59% (Sep 26 2011); shallowest 0.3% (Sep 12 2023), 2.9% (Sep 14 2015), 5.7% (Apr 7 2025); 'a death cross usually appears after a decline has already started'
